title: Security
description: Practices for defending trust boundaries and handling untrusted data.

practices.title: Validate at the boundary
practices.statement: Validate untrusted data once at the trust boundary, then rely on validated types.

practices.title: Fail closed
practices.statement: On validation or verification failure, deny by default; never fall through to a permissive path.

practices.title: No string-built commands
practices.statement: Never build SQL, shell, or path strings from untrusted input; use parameterization and safe APIs.

practices.title: Secrets stay out
practices.statement: Secrets never appear in source, logs, error messages, or test fixtures.

practices.title: Standard cryptography
practices.statement: Use vetted crypto libraries with default modes; never design primitives.
